If you love others, you will want what is best for them, and if that means that you need to tell them they are wrong – then do so. Also we tend to never want to assume responsibility for our actions, as it is always someone else’s fault. Put God in the driver’s seat of your life, and just go along for the ride, following Him in all your ways.
